newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Cambodia still to join ASEAN - Malaysia.
newsitem.headline: Cambodia still to join ASEAN - Malaysia.

text.p: Cambodia, on the brink of civil war, would still be inducted into the Association of South East Asian Nations (ASEAN) as planned next month, Malaysia's Acting Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim said on Monday.

"Our (ASEAN) position has not changed because the commitment has already been made," Anwar told reporters after a banking function. The situation would be reviewed at ASEAN's annual meeting in Kuala Lumpur at the end of this month, he added.
"It is too early and premature to suggest anything, except immediate ceasefire," he said, when asked if ASEAN was proposing any solution to the problem.
Malaysia is the current chairman of ASEAN, which has decided to induct Burma, Cambodia and Laos as the final members of the grouping at a special ceremony on July 23.

"As it stands today, we will negotiate with both the PMs (prime ministers)," he said, when asked who ASEAN would be talking to. He said several messages had been sent to the two leaders through various channels.
